production_callers.supplied_arguments: Add-Result "path:$($tool.name)" $onPath $(if ($onPath) { 'in Machine PATH' } else { 'missing in Machine PATH (run SetGitRoot elevated)' })

Move-LcmProposalLifecycleState -Id $member.Id -State completed -Details "Cohort $CohortId accepted review completed." -Store $store -SkipPersist -CohortId $CohortId -Gate Completion -SynchronizationOutcome synchronized

Open-LcmStandardDisplay -DisplayId tools -Parameters @{
    Audience = $Audience
    Group = $Group
    Role = $Role
    Tool = $Tool
    Env = $Env
    Filter = $Filter
  }
Write-BaselineLog -Level WARN -Message "Macrium backup directory is unavailable: $BackupDirectory"
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message 'WhatIf: would start the configured Macrium backup definition and wait for today''s completed Macrium report.'
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "Detaching existing volume at ${letter}: before mounting '$ImagePath'."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "-NewBaseline specified. Dismounting any existing baseline in candidate drives ($($normalizedDrives -join ', '))..."

Write-BaselineLog -Level WARN -Message "Candidate drive $($cand.MountedDrive) internal log timestamp ($($cand.NewestLogTimestamp)) drifts by $([math]::Round($diffDays, 1)) days from MRMTimeStamp ($mrmTimestampStr)."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "Pushed remote state ($mrPushTimestampStr) is newer than mounted baseline ($mrmTimestampStr)."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "WhatIf: would reuse writable $($mountedBaseline.MountedDrive) Macrium baseline for '$((Resolve-BaselineReviewScope))' via fast-path."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "Set Beyond Compare review title to '$reviewTitle'."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "Reused writable $($mountedBaseline.MountedDrive) Macrium baseline for '$((Resolve-BaselineReviewScope))' via fast-path; $windowDisposition."
Write-BaselineLog -Level WARN -Message "No candidate volume matching '$ExpectedVolumeLabel' found in drives ($($normalizedDrives -join ', ')). Triggering ForceNewBackup..."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "WhatIf: would mount '$($completedImage.ImagePath)' at a Macrium-selected F:-I: drive and launch _LCM for '$reviewIdentity'."
Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "Set Beyond Compare review title to '$reviewTitle'."

Write-BaselineLog -Level INFO -Message "Mounted '$($completedImage.ImagePath)' at $($receipt.MountedDrive); $evidenceSummary; selected RHS review scope '$reviewIdentity' without rewriting the _LCM profile."
Write-DependencyLog -Message 'Validated existing forward and reverse dependency evidence.' -Level PASS
Write-FailureViewerAudit -Event 'Started' -State 'Running' -Message 'Selecting retained evidence; no analysis is collected.'
Write-LcmLog "Defaulting to -Inspect mode (use -Fix to apply changes in-place)."
Write-LcmLog "Target repository folder not found: $repoPath" -Level ERROR
Write-LcmLog "[$($fileItem.Name)] Legacy ASCII box art detected ($($asciiMatches.Count) instance(s)) at: $filePath" -Level WARN
Write-LcmLog "[$($fileItem.Name)] Mermaid box has long line (> $WrapLength chars): '$label'" -Level WARN
Write-LcmLog "[$($fileItem.Name)] Mermaid diagram lacking $($FontSize) constraint at: $filePath" -Level WARN
Write-LcmLog "[$($fileItem.Name)] Table cell has long line (> $TableWrapLength chars)" -Level WARN
Write-LcmLog "[$($fileItem.Name)] Standardized Mermaid formatting & line-folding applied: $filePath" -Level PASS
Write-LcmLog "=== $scriptName v$($scriptVersion) Finished (Evaluated: $filesScanned, Mermaid Blocks: $mermaidBlocksFound, Boxes Folded: $mermaidBoxesFolded, ASCII: $legacyAsciiBoxesFound) ==="
Write-LcmProgressLog "Started progress batch '$actionId' for command '$Command' ($(@($itemObjects).Count) items)."
Write-TimingLog "Loading proposals ledger and activity logs..."
Write-TimingLog "Serializing documents and compiling JSON injection blocks..."
Write-TimingLog "All dispatches completed. Total execution time: $($script:stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)ms"
Write-TimingLog "Browser launch suppressed via -NoLaunch. Total execution time: $($script:stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)ms"
